caption: The drawing features a composition of four adjacent square blocks arranged in a two-by-two grid at the center of a cream or beige background. Each block is constructed from a series of colored rectangular strips, which are layered concentrically around central pale squares to create a stepped or spiral effect. The top left and bottom right blocks contain shades of pink, red, and purple, bordered partially by black strips; the top right block contains lighter pink, brown, green, and tan strips, also bordered in part by black; the bottom left block uses shades of pink, blue, red, and tan, with some black bordering. The blocks meet at the middle, where the borders align to form a plus shape in black, visually connecting all four segments. Each block's interior arrangement of colors differs, but all feature the layering of colored bands building outward from a small pale square.
title: Quilt
